entries.owner: scene node owner plus target-module provider
entries.reason: Scene link dispatch stays module-neutral and drops dead targets through provider-owned liveness checks.
entries.create: The target module registers LinkOps and the scene stores a typed-kind projection.
entries.ownership: Scene owns link records; the provider owns the target object and callback table.
entries.destroy_order: Target teardown unregisters or reports dead before scene link dispatch; scene teardown drops records.
entries.restore: Provider re-registers operations and scene rebuilds link records from persistent node identity.
entries.stale: alive callback is consulted before push/pull; an absent operation id is not dereferenced.

entries.reason: Authoring values have one owner; render resources and scene-link matrices are rebuildable projections.
entries.state: Hierarchy/TRS, source recipes, camera/lighting and persisted relation intent.
entries.authoritative_owner: SceneAuthoringDocumentTarget owns values; SceneEditorSession owns the target and its transaction history. Bound imported SceneHost remains its own live authority.
entries.projections: Director resource cache contains geometry/resources only; native SceneHost projection and Renderable3D linkedWorld are rebuilt. No duplicate script TRS owner.

entries.reason: Scene transform propagation is the authoritative derived transform update system.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: SceneHost trees and mounted scene nodes owned by the scene module.
entries.view: SceneHost-local tree traversal or all-host traversal over generation-checked nodes.
entries.read_set: Local transform, parent links and dirty flags.
entries.write_set: World transform matrices and cleared dirty propagation state.
entries.structural_changes: No node creation/destruction while propagating; mount/reconcile owns structural edits.
entries.events: No external callbacks during propagation; observers read updated transforms after the phase.
entries.services: Borrowed SceneHost registry and injected transform math only.

entries.reason: Complete owning authoring snapshots validate before reversible transactional publication.
entries.schema: eve.scene.authoring; hierarchy, sources, camera, lighting, relations and schemaId/schemaVersion. No native pointers or simulation state.
entries.version: Integer 4; hierarchy v1, optional local-region v1.
entries.migration: Explicit v1/v2/v3 to v4, preserve relations; v1 adds empty relations. Regions require v3; projected_overlap requires v4; unknown fields/versions reject atomically.
entries.unknown_fields: Reject unknown document and payload fields, invalid vector shapes, nonfinite numbers, invalid materials and camera basis.
entries.restore_atomicity: Validate complete candidate and prepare owning copies before swapping hierarchy and payloads. Source preparation occurs before Director command publication; projection failures restore the old document.

entries.reason: MCP, script and editor commands share native document ownership and transaction history.
provides: Existing IEditorAutomationTargetFactory adds scene-authoring; target exposes standard hierarchy/transform/snapshot interfaces.
requires: Scene editing command registry and Editor coordinator. Authoring documents/queries do not require a graphics provider; Director resource projection requires one and reports preparation failure when absent.

requires.fallback: Explicit Unsupported for visual preview/check; physics-only placement remains available.

observes: Stable object ids and owning Value snapshots; optional live targets use existing generation-checked SceneHost links.
binds: SceneEditorModule.createAuthoringSession and inspectAuthoringSnapshot; existing SceneEditorSession command/history/snapshot methods.
SceneEditorSession.prepareRelationVisibility validates owning projection proof; check/commit rerasterize all persisted visual relations.
SceneEditorSession.geometryRevision; Director geometry_revision and regional relations auto-bind missing geometry tokens.
protocol: eve_scene_modify adds ground/align/screen/save/restore/undo/redo/command/bind_host and expectedRevision. Formal scene.authoring.*.v1 and scene.placement.*.v1 commands are owned by scene_editing.
eve_scene_modify relations/relation_begin/relation_update/relation_check/relation_commit/relation_discard; pair-qualified collision-proxy reports and hard relation checks.
entries.thread_affinity: Owner thread; synchronous owning Value conversion, no locks or unknown callbacks. Resources and native scene links use render-thread affinity.

trim.absent_profile: No new trim claim. Native document tests exercise renderer independence; provider absence returns explicit errors.

cost_notes: Geometry inspection transforms eight bounds corners and traverses ancestors per edit. Snapshot and staging copy per document edit; source resource preparation is expensive and precedes publication. Unchanged per-frame refresh checks revision only.
Private world per begin; contacts plus blocking GPU raster/readback per explicit visual check/commit. One adjustable leaf, no per-frame lookup.

evidence: docs/dev/场景对象模型使用指南.md

procgen scene sink absent when scene is trimmed
artifact adapter absent when scene is trimmed
